programs.title: Health Explored S2 - "A Taste of Life Part 2"
programs.desc: Learn about the foods and the culture that makes Sardinia so special. From fishing with their hands, to traditional foods... it's a culinary exploration in good health.

programs.title: Health Explored S2 - "Adaptation"
programs.desc: Travel to La Paz, Bolivia, to see how high altitude impacts the body. From science to tradition, visit the witches market and learn about an ancient Inca medicine for altitude sickness

programs.title: Health Explored S2 - "Superfoods"
programs.desc: The high altitude environment makes foods that are considered "super". From quinoa, to special beans and salt - We travel from the Uyuni Salt flats back to La Paz to work with a Master Chef.

programs.title: Health Explored S2 - "Mother Earth"
programs.desc: Travel to the world's highest lake to see what is happening in this fragile ecosystem. We finish our Bolivian adventure with a ceremony honouring our planet.
